info.name: BHI Health Card Portal API
info.description:
Every endpoint of the BHI Health Card Portal API - 69 routes in 76 requests (some routes have more than one example request).

Source of truth: lib/api-spec/openapi.yaml plus artifacts/api-server/src/routes/. Bodies match the generated Zod schemas, so a request that validates here validates on the server.

## Setup

1. Optionally import the companion environment `BHI-Local.postman_environment.json`. It carries settings only (baseUrl, adminEmail, adminPassword, employeeIdentifier, companyNumber, newCompanyNumber, newClassCode, billingMonth). Tokens and ids are captured into collection variables and are deliberately not in the environment: an environment value, even an empty one, overrides the collection variable the test scripts write.
2. Start the stack: `pnpm run local`. Then `Health / readyz`.
3. Run `Admin - session / Admin login`. It stores `adminToken`; every admin request inherits it. The default account is the super admin (platform.admin@bhi-demo.test / Demo@2026), because companies, classes, rates and billing need it. The two extra login requests switch to the BF HR administrator or the ST client admin to see scoping at work.
4. Employee flow: `Lookup` -> read the code (devCode in OTP dev mode) -> `Verify OTP`. CARD stores `cardToken`; SELECT stores `optionRef` for `Select record after verification`; MULTI_COMPANY ends there and raises a lookup alert.

## The BHI model in one paragraph

Members belong to a company and are addressed as `/v1/admin/companies/{companyNumber}/members/{memberId}` (integer BHI MemberID). They are identified by IDType + IDNumber, unique across the platform. The only status is Active plus InactiveDate/InactiveReason, changed through /deactivate and /reactivate. Dependants and beneficiaries have one fullName each and integer ids. Classes are shared by every company; rates are four tiers per class (standard card or company override) and drive monthly billing runs.

## Demo data (DEMO_SEED)

- Companies: BF Beharry Foods, BA Automotive, BL Logistics, BR Retail, BM Manufacturing, BS Shipping, and ST Sterling Test. Each is a separate company with its own admins; only the super admin reaches more than one.
- Logins, password Demo@2026: platform.admin@bhi-demo.test (super admin), client.foods@bhi-demo.test (BF client admin), client.admin@st.test (ST client admin), hr.foods@bhi-demo.test (BF HR), hr.auto@bhi-demo.test (BA HR), hr@st.test, support@bhi-demo.test, auditor@bhi-demo.test.
- Lookups: +5925550123 (five BF members -> SELECT), shared.contact@bhi-demo.test (BF + ST -> MULTI_COMPANY).
- Classes A, B, C with a standard rate card effective 2026-10-01 (test values).

## Variable capture

| Variable | Set by |
| --- | --- |
| adminToken | Admin login (any of the three) |
| verificationId, otpCode | Lookup / Resend (otpCode only in OTP dev mode); Verification sessions |
| cardToken | Verify OTP (CARD) / Select record |
| optionRef | Verify OTP (SELECT) |
| companyNumber, memberId | List members (memberId also by Create member) |
| dependentId, beneficiaryId | Member detail, Create member, Add dependant, Add beneficiary |
| newCompanyNumber | Onboard company (preset DM) |
| newClassCode | preset D, used by Create/Update class |
| premiumRateId | Rate history, Create rate set |
| billingMonth | preset 2026-10 |
| runId | Generate draft runs, List billing runs |
| changeRequestId | List change requests |
| lookupAlertId | List lookup alerts |
| importExceptionId | Import exceptions (first open one) |
| adminUserId | List admin users, Invite, Onboard company |

## Two different bearer tokens

Admin endpoints take the 8-hour HS256 JWT from login. Employee card endpoints take the 15-minute opaque card token from OTP verify / select. They are not interchangeable.

## Every mutation needs a reason

Admin writes require `reason` (min 3 chars); change-request decisions and lookup-alert resolution require `note` (min 3). Omitting it is a 400.

## Removed since the previous version

POST /v1/lookup/select (choice now happens after verification: /v1/otp/select); every /v1/admin/members/{uuid}/... route (now under /v1/admin/companies/{companyNumber}/members/{memberId}); member and beneficiary /remove (now /deactivate); the employeeNumber / identificationId / employmentStatus / memberStatus fields; the legacy 8-column import layout (400 LAYOUT_WITHDRAWN); the group admin role (ROLE_HR_GROUP_ADMIN), client groups and every /v1/admin/groups route - the super admin is the only role above one company.

request.description:
Body: verificationId (string, required), code (string, exactly 6 chars).

Always 200 once the code is right; `status` says what follows:
- CARD - one record matched. cardToken (opaque, 15-min TTL), expiresAt and confirm { firstName, maskedIdentifier, companyName }. Stored into {{cardToken}}.
- SELECT - several records in ONE company share the contact (a household). options[] = { ref, label } with non-identifying labels; the first ref is stored into {{optionRef}} - run `Select record after verification` next.
- MULTI_COMPANY - the contact matches members in more than one company. No card and no company named; message tells the member to contact HR, and a lookup alert is raised for super admins.

Errors: 400 CODE_INVALID (with attempts left), 400 CODE_EXPIRED, 400 SESSION_INVALID, 423 SESSION_LOCKED after 3 wrong codes. A decoy session (no match at lookup) fails exactly like a wrong code.

Local shortcut: deploy/serve-local.mjs accepts any 6 digits when it holds the delivered code (OTP_ACCEPT_ANY); send header x-otp-strict: 1 to disable.

request.description:
Bearer {{cardToken}}. 12 MB body limit on this route.

All fields required but nullable; at least one requested* field must be present AND differ from the current value (else 400 NO_CHANGES):
- dependentId: a CardDependent.id from Get card (string), or null for yourself (unknown id = 400 UNKNOWN_DEPENDENT)
- requestedFirstName / requestedLastName / requestedDateOfBirth. A dependant has ONE fullName field in the BHI model, so for a dependant the requested first and last names are joined into it.
- requestedRelationship: SPOUSE | SON | DAUGHTER | OTHER (dependants only; ignored for a member subject)
- employeeNote
- document: documentType = NATIONAL_ID | DRIVERS_LICENCE | PASSPORT | BIRTH_CERTIFICATE | MARRIAGE_CERTIFICATE | OTHER; fileName; mimeType = application/pdf | image/jpeg | image/png; contentBase64

Max 5 MB decoded; the MIME type is verified against the magic bytes (the placeholder base64 is a real PDF header). 400 TOO_MANY_PENDING past 3 pending requests.
